newsitem.title: CHINA: China to ban foreign funds for low-grade bearings.
newsitem.headline: China to ban foreign funds for low-grade bearings.

text.p: China will ban all new foreign investment in low-grade bearings production and is calling for overseas investors to focus on the under-supplied high end of the market, the China Daily newspaper said on Tuesday.
China spent $174.63 million on high-grade ball bearing imports in 1995, 2-1/2 times the total in 1990, it said.

Around 80 percent of bearings used in air conditioners, cars and aviation had to be bought on foreign markets and China was calling for overseas investment to boost production in high-grade bearings, the newspaper quoted Sun Zhenbin of the Ministry of Machinery Industry as saying.

"China will no longer approve the establishment of new foreign-invested firms making general-use bearings during the coming five years," Sun said, but gave no details of when the ban would come into force.
